Report:

**Exit codes:** `npm run check:ship` = **0**. `npm test` = **1** (2 failing, both pre-existing/unrelated to `CUSTODY.md` — `test/env-scrub.test.js`'s "A1 mutant proof (driver/server)" walker tests, tripped by a parallel bundle's in-flight, uncommitted edits to `src/server-entry.js` / `driver/host-free-driver.js` / `test/env-scrub.test.js`, none of which I touched). `git status --porcelain` confirms `engine/CUSTODY.md` is my only change.

**Four residual entries added** (Task 1) — placed as two new P2 Ceiling paragraphs + one new Ceiling continuation, and two new Asserted items A7/A8:

1. `opts.cwd`/`opts.stdio` — new P2 Ceiling: *"`opts.cwd` and `opts.stdio` are not scanned by `auditedSpawn` itself. The runtime checks above refuse a secret-shaped value across four channels... but `opts.cwd` and `opts.stdio` pass straight through... This is no longer only a theoretical gap: this fix cycle observed a secret-shaped value ride through `opts.cwd` into a real child... Scope, stated precisely: the value that rode through was caller-supplied, not a credential this package's own custody state had captured..."*
2. Import walker mis-resolution — new **A8**: *"a relative import specifier this package's own reachability tests mis-resolve CONFIDENTLY still classifies wrongly; only the unresolvable case fails closed... The converse is not disclosed anywhere before now..."*
3. `node:` builtins evaluate first — new P2 Ceiling, labelled explicitly: *"`node:` builtins are not exempt from 'whatever a static import reaches evaluates before the entry's own body runs.' ... Named here as a residual in its own right for the first time..."*
4. Preload precedes everything — new P2 Ceiling: *"process-level preload evaluates before this package's own ESM graph, scrub included. Node evaluates `NODE_OPTIONS`, `--require`, and `--import`... Reaching this residual requires control of the launch command line... This residual is not, as of this fix cycle, named on any other surface, shipped or internal."*

**Rotation sentence (Task 2)**, new **A7**: *"a credential rotated mid-session is served STALE by the captured-credential fallback, silently... the next re-scrub deletes the NEW value from `process.env`... but the captured slot keeps serving the OLD value... with no error, no exception, and no signal that a rotation happened... rotation is silently ignored by the fallback path, not silently reflected by it."*

**Task 3 fixes:** `:87` — replaced the false "test-node name reserved for it lives in `test/custody-runtime.test.js`" with the true state (name absent, `check:pointers` classifies `missing-name`). `:66` — re-derived the "first statement" claim to name **both** shipped entries (`src/server-entry.js` and `driver/host-free-driver.js`) instead of only the driver-adjacent one.

**Nothing I couldn't do.** One snag: my first draft of the `opts.cwd`/`opts.stdio` paragraph used the literal text `` `spawn()` `` which tripped `spawn-env-allowlist`'s raw-launch text matcher against `CUSTODY.md` itself — reworded to "the underlying `spawn` invocation" (no bare `spawn(`), re-ran the gate, clean. Did not touch `custody-claim-lint.js` or relax any lint.
